sample_data_type: XML snippets embedded in HTML documentation (not downloadable files)

datasets.name: Patient Dataset
datasets.notes: Reasonable demographic coverage. SSN included. No insurance info.

datasets.name: Encounter Dataset
datasets.notes: Minimal. No encounter type, reason for visit, location, or facility. Sample data shows all doctor name fields populated with NPI value '1234567897' — likely a data masking artifact but obscures field semantics.

datasets.name: Device Dataset
datasets.notes: Good UDI coverage with standard identifiers.

datasets.name: Immunization Dataset
datasets.notes: Basic immunization record. No manufacturer, route, site, or administering provider.

datasets.name: Allergy Dataset
datasets.notes: Basic allergy record with SNOMED coding.

datasets.name: Procedure Dataset
datasets.notes: Includes CPT codes. Sample data shows 1800-01-01 as sentinel null date.

datasets.name: Vital Dataset
datasets.notes: Most detailed dataset. Good vital sign coverage including SpO2 and FiO2. Note: second sample record has a misplaced Unit element outside SpO2 (XML structural issue).

datasets.name: Condition Dataset
datasets.notes: CRITICAL DATA QUALITY ISSUE: ICD10Code field contains GUIDs (e.g., 'f1f0bd65-a248-4930-b981-2531ed4fcd93') instead of actual ICD-10 codes. Description field has the diagnosis text but the code field appears to contain internal database keys.
